title: Stirred exothermic reactor: digital-twin benchmark
description: A well-mixed exothermic reactor with a three-blade impeller and five cooling tubes, reduced from the two-dimensional case a third-party post describes, and the digital twin that follows it through three perturbations (sensor noise, a failed cooling tube, the safety margin against a temperature alarm), measured as state error, latency and alarm detection.

metrics.name: reference_stationary_agreement
metrics.how: algebraic stationary solve against a 16 h marched transient

metrics.name: reference_tolerance_difference
metrics.how: rtol 1e-10 against rtol 1e-12 over a two-hour controlled run

metrics.name: reference_energy_residual
metrics.how: first law over a run with a tube isolated and the impeller stopped

metrics.name: unagitated_temperature
metrics.how: stationary bulk temperature with the impeller stopped, same feed and tubes

metrics.name: unagitated_conversion
metrics.how: stationary conversion with the impeller stopped

metrics.name: feed_needed_for_the_post_point
metrics.how: feed temperature a well-mixed tank needs to sit at the post's 75 °C with 20 % conversion

metrics.name: state_error_temperature_rms
metrics.how: 11 cases: twin against the reference at every sample

metrics.name: state_error_conversion_rms
metrics.how: twin conversion against the reference, percentage points

metrics.name: sensor_error_for_scale
metrics.how: the RTD alone on the same cases: what there is without a twin

metrics.name: open_loop_error_for_scale
metrics.how: the same lumped model with no assimilation, cooling family

metrics.name: latency_median
metrics.how: one twin sample: Kalman predict+update plus the forecast that decides the alarm

metrics.name: alarm_cases_that_crossed
metrics.how: the plant reached the alarm setpoint

metrics.name: alarm_false_alarms
metrics.how: alarms where the plant never crossed

metrics.name: alarm_lead_median
metrics.how: how early the twin's alarm was, median over the detected crossings
